d:
Ganesh Chaturthi is all about welcoming Bappa home with love, devotion and, of course, his favourite modaks!
And since the new generation is always looking for something new to try, this Ganesh Chaturthi, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor gives the classic modak a fun new twist with the Kunafa Modak! Inspired by the viral Kunafa trend, this recipe brings together the much-loved modak and the irresistible crunch of Kunafa, with Nutralite Choco Spread Crunchy bringing delicious chocolatey flavour and a wholesome touch to the filling.
